item: Add the details that read the truck, on the body built in P0. The frozen count in subjects/pickup/census.json is 3 windows (the windshield plus one side window per door, role window, a glass pane seated in a recess at most 0.02 m deep in the cab face, its back overlapping the recess floor - never a hole through the cab), 2 headlights (role headlight, a mirror pair on the nose face either side of the grille) and 2 mirrors (role mirror, a mirror pair on the cab sides, each on a short arm that meets the cab). Add the grille between the headlights (role grille), recessed slots on the nose face, and a door line on each cab side as a shallow groove at most 0.02 m deep cut into the side face only, or a thin proud strip (role cab) - never a cut through the cab, its base or its seat on the chassis. Mirror pairs are exact: place one side and put its partner at the negated x, same y and z. Sizes and positions from subjects/pickup/layout.json: the headlight centres sit at headlight.centreY of H and headlight.offsetX of W either side of the centre plane, each lamp headlight.diameter of W across; the grille slot field is grille.w of W by grille.h of H; the mirror centres sit at mirror.centreY of H and mirror.offsetX of W, each head mirror.head.w of W by mirror.head.h of H on an arm mirror.arm.length of W long; the windshield pane is window.front.w of W wide with its lower edge at window.front.bottom of H; the near side window runs from window.side.start to window.side.end of L from the nose, between window.side.bottom and window.side.top of H. Read the numbers and multiply - do not invent a metre. Every part is at least 0.04 m on every axis, touches the body, and does not reach the ground. Build each mirror as TWO parts: the head (role mirror, the larger block, measured by mirror.head.w and mirror.head.h) and a separate thin arm (role mirror) joining it to the cab; never one merged block. Layout keys this pass must satisfy: headlight.centreY, headlight.offsetX, headlight.diameter, grille.w, grille.h, mirror.centreY, mirror.offsetX, mirror.head.w, mirror.head.h, mirror.arm.length, window.front.w, window.front.bottom, window.side.start, window.side.end, window.side.bottom, window.side.top. Done looks like: from the solved camera the windshield and the near side window read as pale glass in the cab, two round yellow lamps flank a dark grille on the nose at screen-left, and a mirror stands out from each A-pillar. You may reopen any earlier part if the LOOK checklist for it failed; the previous review lists the failed rows.
